requirement: Iteration and exhaustion obligations match inputs

obligations.note: Loop header; entered once per call regardless of iteration count, including zero iterations.

notes: The zero-iteration case is the implicit-branch check: line 6 is never reached but line 7 still is, proving the loop's zero-body-executions path is distinguished from a crash or early exit. The 'many' case additionally checks that a count contract, if one is claimed, multiplies correctly (3 body executions, not 1).
